experiments.hypothesis: A source-pinned calibration-only binary-basis quantizer could improve model footprint on a qualified owner GPU while preserving a preregistered quality floor.
experiments.control: matched BF16 and established 4-bit quantizer, identical base-model revision, prompt set, GPU and batching
experiments.negative_control: adversarial prompts + perturbation/roundtrip checksum + kernel arithmetic versus FP32 reference

experiments.hypothesis: A bounded gate-projection deletion-mask experiment could lower adapter storage and forgetting under matched compute relative to LoRA and full fine-tuning.
experiments.control: same base/dataset/steps/seeds compute budget across no-op mask, random mask, LoRA and matched fine-tune
experiments.negative_control: random masks, frozen baseline, held-out prior tasks and contamination check

experiments.hypothesis: Bounded, verified single-component harness patches could improve completion per token without exploiting the evaluator or changing model weights.
experiments.control: same model SHA, immutable tasks, tokens and tool budget for no-update, reflection-only and full-harness rewrite
experiments.negative_control: withheld-evaluator mutation tests, fabricated tool-success signals, benchmark leakage and rollback injection

experiments.hypothesis: Explicit constraint-energy descent might reduce search cost on carefully controlled CSP tasks without weakening unique-solution certification.
experiments.control: SAT/SMT-certified solver and fixed-budget looped model with identical puzzle difficulty distribution
experiments.negative_control: nonunique/inconsistent puzzles, paraphrase-drift, changed-clue and hard grammar generalization

experiments.hypothesis: Provenance-bound KG attention caches may improve long-tail factual recall while maintaining tenant/invariant isolation and limiting GPU memory.
experiments.control: immutable RAG retrieval + current invariant-keyed paged-KV with same graph subset and latency/VRAM budget
experiments.negative_control: revoked facts, tenant cross-boundary, changed KG revision, stale-edge poison and no-evidence abstention

experiments.hypothesis: Before entering any competition, an independent small-scale reproducibility harness can quantify whether existing SZL scientific tools approximate validated physical reference calculations.
experiments.control: public reference tasks and established computational-chemistry/heat-transfer solver baseline under matched error/cost budgets
experiments.negative_control: unit/dimensional mismatch, unphysical material parameters, time-step instability and reference-label leakage

experiments.hypothesis: Harness- and cost-normalized independent evaluations can prevent misleading cross-provider leaderboard claims in SZL public model cards.
experiments.control: same benchmark version, evaluator revision, harness, budget/timeouts and pass policy across models
experiments.negative_control: mixing vendor and independent scores, changing harness limits, selection on successful attempts only
